title.narrative: In 2024, through strategic advocacy, communication, brand building and strengthening of SBC capacity, the Communications Section helped advance UNICEF Brazil’s key priorities in the new country programme, in close collaboration with internal and external partners from the government, civil society, the private sector, media, youth and influencers. We leveraged key opportunities and milestones, such as the G20 being hosted in Brazil, municipal elections, the closing of the flagship programmes Selo and Agenda Cidade UNICEF cycles, and others to engage targeted audiences to prioritize and advance our child rights agenda.
